title: Real analysis
purpose: Prove the foundational statements behind calculus and distinguish pointwise from uniform convergence.

blocks.deliverable: Prove a continuous image or extreme value result.
Week 7 proof midterm; give a counterexample to a false converse.
State and prove a theorem with all hypotheses.
Compare pointwise and uniform limits explicitly.
Defend the portfolio and complete a proof examination.

project: Build a proof portfolio illustrating when limits, derivatives and integrals can be interchanged.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
